thread:
liam: Observed a ~3% 5xx spike from EU1 autocomplete starting ~14:02 UTC. Affects regen and small batch jobs. Noticed tokenizer mem growth. ops-oncall, can you tail logs?
ops-oncall: On it — tailing logs now, correlating with v3.2.1 deploys. Suspect tokenizer off-by-one regression in token mapper.
deploy-bot: Hotfix candidate created: redwood-inference/model-autocomplete@v3.2.2-hotfix-eu
Canary plan: 5% -> 25% after 15m -> 100% after 45m
Change window: immediate (EU business hours), expedited approvals required (SRE + Eng + PM)
Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 2.0% OR p95 latency +150ms sustained 5m
Run command: ```/deploy model-autocomplete v3.2.2-hotfix --region eu1 --canary 5 --monitor 15m```
jen: tagging @maya @saul for quick approvals. QA ran basic smoke; we need SRE signoff before canary.
maya: QA checked core user journeys — search, completion, reranker smoke passed. +1 but recommend watching embeddings reranker path.
saul: SRE conditional +1 if auto-rollback and circuit-breaker stay active. Also request pin fallback pool ready (eu-pool-2).
liam: Confirm pin fallback to dedicated eu-pool-2 is ready; we can redirect traffic there on rollback. Release notes (short): fixes tokenizer off-by-one causing mem spikes under certain inputs. Cherrypick includes tokenizer bounds check.
ops-oncall: Starting deploy in 2m. Will monitor traces, logs, and error budget dashboard. Will escalate immediately if rollback happens. :eyes:
deploy-bot: /deploy initiated by ops-oncall
Canary at 5%: metrics so far 0.2% 5xx, p95 latency stable
saul: Seeing KV cache warmup, throughput looks stable at 5% canary. No backend thundering. :thumbsup:
liam: Standard rule: if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m -> rollback. Ops, call if rollback triggers.
ops-oncall: Roger. Pager rules are active. Will annotate timeline.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 25% after 15m — no regressions detected. Scheduled to ramp to 100% in 30m unless thresholds breached.
jen: Adding release note link and changelog PR: https://git.internal/r/9876 (cherrypick and small test additions)
maya: Granting expedited signoff from QA side — will follow up with regression suite run. :shipit:
saul: SRE approves final ramp with auto-rollback and circuit-breaker enabled. If rollback fires, we'll fallback to eu-pool-2 and open incident channel.
liam: Thanks team. Post-mortem only if rollback or customer impact. Logging the decision and owners.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% by ops-oncall; final health: 0.3% 5xx, p95 latency nominal. Auto-rollback not triggered.
ops-oncall: Monitoring 30m post-rollout. Closing expedited approval loop. Great coordination. :white_check_mark:
